blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **научиться → научишься** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**пожелать → пожелаешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**влететь → влетит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Read out the entire list, please.
exercises.why: **огласить → Огласите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**обновить → Обновите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Can I open the window? It's boiling hot in here.
exercises.why: **откроить → открою** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**оправдать → оправдает** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если ты ___ (повернуть) направо, перед тобой будет здание муниципалитета.
exercises.prompt: If you turn right, City Hall will be right in front of you.
exercises.why: **повернуть → повернёшь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**импортировать → импортирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Give me a little of your time.
exercises.why: **уделить → Уделите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если ___ (пройти) хорошо, я выдвину тебя на драматический сериал.
exercises.prompt: If it goes well, I'll put you forward for a drama serial.
exercises.why: **пройти → пройдёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Этот дизайнер настольных игр ___ (классифицировать) их по количеству компонентов.
exercises.prompt: This game design specialist classifies board games by the number of player pieces.
exercises.why: **классифицировать → классифицирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**продолжить → продолжат** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's get a picture of us with the sea in the background.
exercises.why: **сфотографироваться → сфотографируемся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**наполнить → Наполните** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я ___ (принять) это, как само собой разумеющееся.
exercises.why: **принять → приму** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: This is a great time-saving gadget for the housewife.
exercises.why: **сэкономить → сэкономит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: One never knows whom one might run into.
exercises.why: **нарваться → нарвёшься** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**случиться → случится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**сводить → сводит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
